title: Fixed class-free ambient unit tail
statement: For any commutative condensed coefficient Lambda, projective-line base Y, Tate family L, shifted second-line comparison e, derived M on P and invertibility witnesses hb,hp, define unitTail from Rp2*(p1*M(1)[2]) to q*Rq*M(1)[2] as inverse twistProjectionMap followed by twist of the inverse ambient exchange. The helper ambientExchangeInverse is exactly the native inverse expressed using the fixed module-object functor names. Prove unitComponent equals its pushSection/class insertion followed by unitTail, for any Diagram d. All definitions are literal fixed composites, without class or trace data chosen anew.

proof.text: Construct the ambient exchange inverse through the module-object functor wrappers at a generic square, then compose it with the inverse twist projection. Unfold these explicit definitions and unitComponent to prove unitComponent_factor by definitional equality, allowing full local reduction of the derived-instance wrappers.

lean.statement: def unitTail : (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (secondProjection Y)).obj ((twist Λ (diagonalSurface Y) (L (diagonalSurface Y))).obj ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (firstProjection Y)).obj M)) ⟶ (twist Λ (ProjectiveLine Y) (L (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M))
